title: AgentBank: Banking on Blockchain Agentic Payments
abstract: arXiv:2611.32389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents increasingly pay for data and computation through protocols such as x402 and AP2, but individually funded wallets idle and require asset transfers for every payment. We present AgentBank, a smart-contract banking layer that lets agents spend bank liabilities under owner-issued mandates and on-chain spending limits. Internal payments update account balances without transferring assets, while pooled backing funds are allocated between reserves and yield-bearing strategies. We bound losses from compromised agent keys and analyze how correlated demand affects reserve requirements. Experiments show that AgentBank reduces idle liquidity by 52-77% relative to per-agent wallets and lowers gas costs for batched internal payments. Using historical DeFi liquidity data, we evaluate how reserve policies balance treasury returns against payment availability during market stress. translated_title: AgentBank：面向区块链智能体支付的银行系统
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地通过x402和AP2等协议为数据和计算付费，但单独注资的钱包会导致资金闲置，且每次支付都需要进行资产转移。我们提出了AgentBank，一个智能合约银行层，使智能体能够在所有者授权和链上支出限额下动用银行负债进行支付。内部支付通过更新账户余额完成，无需转移资产，同时集合的支撑资金在储备与收益型策略之间进行配置。我们对智能体密钥泄露造成的损失进行了界定，并分析了需求相关性如何影响储备金要求。实验表明，与每个智能体单独持有钱包的方案相比，AgentBank将闲置流动性降低了52-77%，并降低了批量内部支付的gas成本。利用历史DeFi流动性数据，我们评估了储备政策如何在市场压力期间平衡金库收益与支付可用性。我们进一步研究了自动化银行挤兑的风险，并评估……（原文在此截断）
tldr: AgentBank提出了一种智能合约银行层，让AI智能体在所有者授权与链上支出限额下直接动用银行负债进行内部支付而无需逐笔转移资产，可将闲置流动性降低52-77%并降低批量支付的gas成本，同时通过储备策略和损失界定来管理安全与流动性风险。
en_tdlr: AgentBank introduces a smart-contract banking layer that lets AI agents spend bank liabilities under owner-issued mandates and on-chain spending limits, eliminating per-payment asset transfers to reduce idle liquidity by 52-77% and lower gas costs for batched payments, while managing key-compromise losses and reserve policies against market stress.
